title: Below Thirty-Fourth

objectives.text: The Arden boiler room. Get the box.
A token, a turnstile, and Brannock
Lose them in the dark passage
Brannock catches up on the platform
objectives.note: Content rule: no instructional detail about the third rail; it's a visible 'do not' hazard only. Cops among the targets are ordinary killable police (heat only).

objectives.text: Take the downtown local to 23rd St
objectives.note: Ride one stop; the train is a moving set (sway, flickering lights, graffiti cars).

objectives.text: Box to Hanyang House, W 32nd St
Back to the Arden. Tina's waiting.

fail.note: Wasted: retry from checkpoint (hospital flow, Gameplay).
Arrested: retry from checkpoint (booking flow, Gameplay).
Shown as '<Name> died'. Retry from checkpoint; offer a skip after repeated failures.

rewards.payNote: Delphine's fee for carrying the club money underground. The club's $18,000 is moved, not earned.

mobile: The underground is navigated by lit signs and the passage's single track of bulbs; route knowledge (the passage links Herald Square to Penn Station) is the solution. Rats are a startle, not damage. The train arrival is telegraphed 6+ seconds ahead. Melee on soft lock.
design: **The subway story mission** (user: 'Maybe a mission in the subways'). Uses what only the subway has: a token booth and turnstiles, a half-abandoned pedestrian passage from Herald Square toward Penn Station (real; sources differ on when it closed, 1970s or c.1990), rats, a platform fight with a train coming, and a one-stop ride on a graffiti-covered local. Content rule: the third rail is a visible hazard with no instructional detail. Then the kye hand-off and Tina's confession, as before.
conventions: FEATURE_AUDIT 'Mission conventions': cop kills feed heat only; 'Lose the police' gates on requireNoHeat objectives; fail only for standard reasons.
